payload.name: Enumerate Visited Place Categories
payload.description: When a question asks what kinds of places (cafes, parks, shelters, events) a person or two named people have checked out or visited, and one generic places query returns sparse results.
content: When a question asks what kinds of places a person or pair has visited/checked out, do not stop after one generic 'places' query; run targeted hybrid or keyword searches for each likely place category (dining, outdoor/hiking, pet-related, entertainment, events) with the person's name and category terms.

Search across event, plan, and state memories, but count a place as checked out only when a memory explicitly states a visit, attendance, or discovery (visited, went to, attended, discovered); exclude plans, intentions, and still-searching-for statements.
Stop once the distinct place types named across searches have all been covered, or after at most three targeted category searches beyond the initial query.

solves: Questions that ask what kinds of places a person (or pair) has visited or checked out around a city often fail when one generic 'places' query retrieves only a few memories; this skill requires searching by place category and excluding planned or sought places so the answer is a complete, evidence-supported enumeration.
